title: Final showdown with Mo Xingtian
summary: On the summit of Holy Spirit Mountain, Mu Chen and Mo Xingtian of the Dragon Demon Palace begin their final showdown, while Xia Youran and Wen Busheng hold off Liu Ying, Dong Yuan and Zhou Xuan, the three Mo Xingtian brought up with him. Mo Xingtian draws the Dragon-Devouring Demon Spear, the Dragon Demon Palace's peerless spirit artifact, and shows he is well beyond merely passing the Human Body Disaster. Mu Chen answers by turning the palace's own ultimate treasure, the Great Meru Demonic Pillar, against its prized prodigy, and tells Mo Xingtian that after years on North Heaven's bounty list it is time he answered for it. The watchers are reminded that the Holy Spirit Baptism, like the Spiritual Academy Competition, is a contest among prodigies, and they wonder whether Mu Chen can win and how many trump cards he still has.
